jobs.title: Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II
jobs.description: **Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II** **Role Overview:** As a Lead Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer II , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands\-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high\-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost\-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte's engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship and advanced proficiency across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering\-together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio\-consistently demonstrating your exemplary track record in operating high\-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a role\-model leader and mentor, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to set production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Outcome\-Driven Accountability:** Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service\-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability\-ensuring high\-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient. * **Technical Leadership and Advocacy:** Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Set production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production\-gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow. * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre\-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability\-codified, version\-controlled dashboards and SLO\-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient\-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands\-on, self\-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks\-operating as an infrastructure\-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high\-quality, supportable automation; and review the work of other engineers, mentoring them, to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co\-defining service\-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery. * **Incremental and Iterative Delivery:** Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning\-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements\-progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement\-rather than big\-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration and Integration:** Work collaboratively with empowered, cross\-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Set production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co\-define service\-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production\-holding the segregation\-of\-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation. * **Advanced Technical Proficiency:** Possess deep expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering\-cloud platform ownership, observability l development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 6\+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large\-scale, distributed, cloud\-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C\#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks. * 3\+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large\-scale systems\-defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on\-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging\-e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre\-production and production; and segregation\-of\-duties controls (least\-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk. * 3\+ years of experience with cloud\-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP\-including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI\-plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure\-as\-code, networking, and multi\-environment management. * 1\+ years of experience establishing reliability and operational standards\-SLO discipline, runbooks, and performance and resilience budgets\-including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding team members in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards. * Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production\-their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side. * Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution). * Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI\-augmented spec\-driven development. * Prior experience using methodologies \& tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi\-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high\-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale. * Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to one of the select locations available for this role * Ability to work in your local office at a minimum of 3 days per week **Other:** * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. EA\_ExpHire

As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom\-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge internal and go\-to\-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. **Qualifications** **Required:** * A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. * 5 \+ years of hands\-on experience with ServiceNow development, including JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, UI Actions, Client Scripts, Flow Designer, ServiceNow APIs, and GlideRecord queries. * 5 \+ years of experience with ServiceNow cloud\-native platform capabilities such as ITSM, ITOM, CMDB, ITBM, HRSD, CSM, and ServiceNow integration. * 1 \+ year of experience with ServiceNow AI/ML and GenAI features such as Predictive Intelligence, Virtual Agent, and Now Intelligence. * Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build. * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available. **Preferred:** * Experience with cloud\-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro\-services on cloud hyper\-scalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Prior software engineering experience with an understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCDs), sequence, activity, state, entity relationship, and data flow diagrams, as well as OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentation. * Prior experience using methodologies and tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, and SonarQube to rapidly deliver high\-quality solutions, as well as familiarity with ServiceNow\-specific tools like ServiceNow Studio, Automated Test Framework (ATF), and ServiceNow CI/CD practices. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today's threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com **Job summary** Quantum computers are coming — and when they arrive, the encryption protecting most of the world's digital infrastructure will need to change. DigiCert Quantum Central is the platform helping enterprises get ahead of that transition: discovering cryptographic assets, identifying vulnerabilities, prioritizing remediation, and managing their migration to post\-quantum cryptography (PQC). The Quantum Central engineering team is looking for a full stack Senior Software Engineer to help build this platform from the ground up. This is greenfield, high\-impact work on a problem the industry hasn't fully solved yet. You'll design APIs, own features end\-to\-end, and ship software that some of the world's largest organizations depend on to stay secure. We move fast. We use AI as a force multiplier. And we hold the bar high on quality — because in security, cutting corners isn't an option. **What you will do** * Build RESTful, highly scalable cloud\-native services in Go and TypeScript * Own features end\-to\-end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and observability * Use AI coding agents (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, etc.) as a native part of your daily workflow — fluently, not occasionally * Design and ship software using agentic AI workflows: LLM orchestration, autonomous pipelines, and AI\-assisted product features where relevant to the Quantum Central platform * Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and security researchers to build PQC readiness tooling the market doesn't yet have * Engage with engineering leaders to implement industry best practices and drive technical decisions * Analyse, troubleshoot, and debug product defects and deliver timely solutions * Develop a deep understanding of post\-quantum cryptography, PKI, and the cryptographic asset landscape **What you will have** * \+5 years of professional software engineering experience * Expert proficiency in **Go** for designing and building RESTful, cloud\-native web services * Strong **TypeScript** backend development skills * **Fluency with AI coding agents** (Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar) as a daily, production workflow — you use them to ship faster and with higher quality, and you bring the judgment to review what they produce * **Hands\-on experience building with agentic AI workflows**: LLM API integration, function\-calling pipelines, autonomous agents, or AI\-assisted development pipelines in production or near\-production systems * Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: design, testing, architecture, and code quality * Experience with service\-based architectures and distributed systems * Solid understanding of relational databases, SQL best practices, indexes, and query optimization * Familiarity with Test Automation Frameworks and CI/CD pipelines * Exposure to AWS or equivalent cloud infrastructure * Ability to identify where AI can accelerate delivery and advocate for AI\-first engineering practices within the team * Strong communication and collaboration skills **Nice to have** * Understanding of **post\-quantum cryptography (PQC)**, SSL/TLS, PKI, or cryptographic asset management * Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (Kyber, Dilithium, etc.) * Experience with cryptographic discovery tools, CMDB integrations, or security posture management platforms * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent industry experience * Experience building **multi\-agent AI systems** or RAG\-based features integrated into real product workflows * Technologies and tools we use — any experience is a bonus: * + Go + MySQL / MariaDB + React / Redux + Java + Docker and Kubernetes + Git and GitHub + Jira API / ITSM integrations **What We're Really Looking For** --------------------------------- Beyond the technical requirements, we're looking for someone with a specific mindset: * AI\-native, not AI\-curious. You've already internalized AI coding agents into your daily workflow. You know their strengths, their failure modes, and how to prompt them effectively. You use them to move faster without letting them move carelessly. * Speed with judgment. You understand that "ship fast" and "ship quality" aren't opposites — they're a discipline. You know when to iterate quickly and when to slow down and get it right. * You treat features like your name is on them, because it is. *DigiCert is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.* **Benefits** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings programs with company matching (401(k) or RRSP) * Generous paid time off, including holidays, and vacation * Paid parental leave and family support benefits * Life and disability coverage * Flexible spending and health savings options (where applicable) * Health and wellness support, including gym reimbursement and wellness programs * Employee Assistance Program with 24/7confidential support for employees and families * Education assistance and professional development opportunities * Access to LinkedIn Learning and continuous learning resources * Employee referral bonus program and additional company perks and discounts * Internal rewards and recognition platform (Motivosity) to celebrate and acknowledge project wins, milestone achievements, and the outstanding contributions of our colleagues * Business travel insurance and global employee support programs To protect candidate information and maintain a secure hiring process, all applications must be submitted through our careers portal. jobs.description: **Dirt Excavation Superintendent** ================================== **Large\-Scale Heavy Civil Construction \& Earthmoving Projects** **Position Title:** Dirt Excavation Superintendent **Location:** Project\-Based **Reports To:** Project Manager / VP of Operations **Position Summary** -------------------- Doss Enterprises is seeking an experienced **Dirt Excavation Superintendent** to oversee and direct all field operations on large\-scale, multimillion\-dollar excavation and site development projects. This position is responsible for managing earthwork production, utility installation, blasting coordination, workforce leadership, equipment utilization, safety compliance, schedule performance, and cost control while delivering exceptional project results. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing heavy civil construction projects involving mass excavation, grading, underground utilities, blasting operations, haul road construction, and site development. The Superintendent must be a results\-driven leader capable of maximizing production, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring efficient utilization of labor and equipment resources. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- ### **Project Leadership \& Execution** * Lead all daily field operations on large\-scale earthmoving and site development projects. * Direct and supervise foremen, operators, laborers, truck drivers, subcontractors, and utility crews. * Develop and execute work plans to meet project schedules, budgets, and production goals. * Coordinate excavation, grading, embankment, utility installation, and site development activities. * Monitor daily production quantities and adjust resources to optimize efficiency. * Ensure projects achieve or exceed performance expectations while maintaining quality standards. * Drive accountability and a high\-performance culture among field personnel. ### **Earthwork \& Excavation Management** * Manage mass excavation, rock excavation, grading, cut/fill balancing, and embankment construction activities. * Interpret grading plans, site plans, utility plans, and project specifications. * Coordinate equipment deployment to maximize production and minimize downtime. * Oversee GPS machine control operations and grade control systems. * Monitor compaction testing and ensure compliance with project requirements. ### **Utility \& Pipe Installation** * Oversee installation of: + Storm sewer systems + Sanitary sewer systems + Water distribution systems + Force mains + Drainage structures + Culverts and related infrastructure * Ensure proper trenching, bedding, backfill, and testing procedures are followed. * Coordinate inspections and utility acceptance requirements. ### **Blasting Operations** * Coordinate blasting activities with specialized contractors. * Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations related to blasting. * Manage excavation sequencing before and after blasting activities. * Maintain site safety and communication protocols during blasting operations. ### **Scheduling \& Production Tracking** * Develop short\-term and long\-term project execution plans. * Monitor progress against schedules using daily production tracking. * Coordinate manpower, transportation, materials, and equipment resources. * Identify and resolve project obstacles proactively. * Participate in planning meetings and project updates. ### **HCSS \& Technology Utilization** * Utilize **HCSS HeavyJob, Dispatcher, and related software platforms** for: + Daily reporting + Production tracking + Cost coding + Equipment utilization monitoring + Labor tracking + Productivity analysis * Interpret project performance data and implement corrective actions as necessary. * Collaborate with Project Managers to improve field efficiency and project profitability. ### **Safety \& Compliance** * Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations and company safety standards. * Conduct safety meetings, toolbox talks, and site inspections. * Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions. * Promote a culture of safety and jobs.title: Lead Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION OVERVIEW** We're consolidating analytics onto a single SQL Server database that sits right alongside our lending systems, and you'll own it end to end: what lands in it, how it's modeled, and the reporting that runs off it. jobs.description: We are a rapidly growing, Boston\-based medical technology company using AI to enable clinicians to make informed decisions on cardiovascular care \- leading to better patient outcomes, improved quality of care, and reduced healthcare costs. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Build the Future with Us —** **EquipmentShare is Hiring a** **Senior Software Engineer** ========================================================================================== At EquipmentShare, we're not just filling a role — **we're assembling the best team on the planet to build something that's never been built before**. We're on a mission to transform an industry that's been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real\-time support, and a team that truly cares. We're hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** at our Corporate Headquarters in **Columbia, MO**, and we're looking for someone who's ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. This position is fully remote. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us continue to build the next evolution of our data and AI platform in a scalable, performant and customer\-centric oriented architecture. Our main tech stack includes : *AWS, Kubernetes, Python, Kafka, Flink, Snowflake, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, CDKTF/Terraform.* If you have production scale experience in a different stack (Go, Java, Scala, C\#, etc.) and are interested in moving to a new stack, we should chat. ### **Primary Responsibilities** * Design, build and maintain our data and AI platform to enable automation and self\-service for data scientists, analytics engineers and analysts. * Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Data Scientists and Data Analysts to take ideas from concept to production at scale. * Exert your passion and use deep and wide thinking to shape the technical direction of the platform. * Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, Product Managers, Designers and Engineers to take ideas from concept to delivery. Balancing the desire to ship code with the responsibility to get it right. * Contribute to our culture improving how we deliver as a team. Helping us to leave things better than we find them and making it easier for us to get stuff done. * Support, coach and mentor Engineers within our team by sharing your insight, knowledge and experience as we learn and grow together. ### **Why EquipmentShare?** Because we do things differently — and we think you'll feel it from day one. We're a people\-first company powered by cutting\-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn't just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you're behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports *you*, and you drive *us* forward. We're a team of problem\-solvers, go\-getters, and builders. And we're looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of **building something special**. #### **Perks \& Benefits** Competitive compensation * Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full\-time employees * Generous PTO \+ paid holidays * 401(k) \+ company match * Gym membership stipend \+ wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!) * Company events, food truck nights * 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home * * Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities ### **About You** You want to be part of a team that's not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we're transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you're excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment. We're looking for people who: See challenges as opportunities * Embrace change and continuous improvement * * Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day ### **Skills \& Qualifications** * + 7\+ years of relevant development experience building production grade solutions. + 5\+ years leading design of reliable and scalable services and APIs. + Practical production knowledge of SaaS products. + Proficient with a high order object oriented language. (especially Python \- open to Go, Java, Scala, C\# etc.) + Exposure to event driven architectures and high volume data processing. + Practical experience with events stream processing, transformation and enrichment using technologies such as Flink and Kafka. + Practical exposure of CI/CD pipelines for your production services. + Familiarity with public cloud service platforms. + Experience partnering and collaborating with remote teams (across different time zones). + Proven track record in learning new technologies and applying that learning quickly. + Experience building observability and monitoring into applications.### **Some of the things that would be nice to have, but not required:** + Familiar with change data capture (CDC). + Experience with ML or AI platforms such as Metaflow. + Familiar with containerization and Kubernetes. + Familiar with (IaC) such as Terraform. ### **A Workplace For All** At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — *A Workplace For All* — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life. We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do. **EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.** ***Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.***

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Experlogix is a leading provider of Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) software solutions that empower businesses to streamline their sales processes and drive revenue growth. Our innovative technology integrates seamlessly with ERP and CRM systems, providing our clients with comprehensive solutions to optimize their sales operations. **Position: Technical Support Engineer** **Location:** US or Canada Remote Do you enjoy digging into technical problems and finding creative solutions? Are you passionate about technology and interested in learning how complex software systems work? If so, we'd love to hear from you. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your technical troubleshooting skills while working with enterprise software used by organizations around the world. You'll gain hands\-on experience with leading CRM and ERP platforms, SQL Server, web technologies, and cloud\-hosted applications—all while building highly transferable technical skills. This is not your typical call center support position. You'll work alongside experienced technical professionals to troubleshoot customer issues, collaborate with Engineering and Professional Services, and continually expand your technical expertise in a supportive, team\-oriented environment. Experlogix is seeking a Technical Support Engineer with strong technical aptitude and a passion for solving software problems. The ideal candidate enjoys understanding how software works, is comfortable troubleshooting databases, web applications, and integrations, and has experience with .NET technologies—or a strong desire to learn them. In this role, you'll provide high\-quality technical support for our CPQ software and its integrations with ERP and CRM platforms while working closely with teammates to resolve customer issues and grow your technical knowledge. This is a remote position and can be located anywhere within the United States or Canada. **Responsibilities** * Serve as a technical support resource for customer deployments and upgrades, providing timely and effective resolutions that contribute to customer success. * Diagnose and troubleshoot issues related to Experlogix CPQ software, SQL Server databases, ERP and CRM integrations, and web\-based applications. * Collaborate with Product Development, Professional Services, and other cross\-functional teams to investigate and resolve technical issues. * Develop and maintain technical expertise in Experlogix products, Microsoft technologies, ERP systems, CRM platforms, and SQL Server. * Document troubleshooting steps, root causes, and resolutions within the company knowledge base. * Identify recurring issues and provide feedback that improves product quality, support processes, and customer experiences. * Participate in ongoing technical training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to continually expand your technical skill set. * Escalate complex or product\-related issues appropriately while maintaining ownership of customer communication and follow\-through. **Skills \& Qualifications** * 1\+ year of experience in technical support, application support, software development, IT support, or a similar technical role. * Experience supporting enterprise software solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, NetSuite, or other ERP and CRM platforms is preferred but not required. * Basic to intermediate understanding of Microsoft SQL Server, including the ability to write SQL queries for troubleshooting and data analysis. * Working knowledge of web server technologies such as Internet Information Services (IIS), Windows Server, Apache, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with web technologies including XML, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and REST\-based APIs. * Exposure to object\-oriented programming concepts or scripting languages is helpful. Experience with .NET is a plus, but a willingness to learn is equally valued. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate technical issues, identify potential causes, and determine appropriate solutions. * Experience configuring virtual machines and remote desktop connections is helpful. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Curiosity, persistence, and a passion for learning new technologies and solving technical problems. * Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional service. * Certifications related to Microsoft SQL Server, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Azure, or CPQ technologies are a plus but not required. **Find Your Passion at Experlogix** At Experlogix, we strive to create a culture of engaged, collaborative team members who are passionate about solving problems and helping customers succeed. We believe in building careers—not just filling jobs—and provide opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and internal growth. Our purpose is to fuel your passion through rewarding work, meaningful challenges, and opportunities to make an impact. See why we were recognized as a Top 10 Microsoft Dynamics Marketplace solution and one of the best software and service companies in Silicon Slopes. **Our Company** Experlogix is a rapidly growing, award\-winning leader in Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) technology. We specialize in fully integrated quote and order automation solutions for Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, and NetSuite. With offices in the United States, Canada, Belgium, and the Netherlands, along with remote team members around the globe, we're committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer experiences. **Benefits** * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance * Voluntary Disability Insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * 401(k) with Company Match * Teladoc Virtual Healthcare * Health Advocate Program * Paid Holidays and Generous PTO—we encourage you to use it! * Flexible work environment with accountability and trust * Opportunities for ongoing technical learning and career advancement

jobs.title: Senior Electronics Lab Technician
jobs.description: **Senior Electronics Lab Technician****Department:** ID3 – Engineering / Production **Location:** Atlanta, GA **Position Summary** ID3 is seeking an experienced **Senior Electronics Lab Technician** to support the design, development, testing, assembly, and maintenance of custom electronic systems used in experiential marketing, exhibits, trade shows, branded environments, and interactive displays. This position plays a key role in transforming engineering concepts into reliable, production\-ready solutions while ensuring the highest standards of quality, safety, and performance. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on electronics professional with strong troubleshooting abilities, experience building and testing prototypes, and a passion for solving complex technical challenges in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities*** Build, wire, assemble, and test electronic prototypes, control panels, and custom assemblies. * Troubleshoot analog and digital electronic circuits, wiring systems, power supplies, sensors, LED systems, controllers, and communication devices. * Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, PCB layouts, and engineering drawings. * Perform diagnostics and root cause analysis on electrical and electronic failures. * Assist engineers with prototype development, design validation, and product improvements. * Configure, calibrate, and maintain laboratory equipment including oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, signal generators, and network testing devices. * Support firmware loading, software updates, and basic programming of embedded devices when required. * Document testing procedures, inspection results, and engineering changes. * Create and maintain accurate bills of materials (BOMs), wiring documentation, and assembly instructions. * Ensure all products comply with quality standards and customer specifications. * Maintain inventory of electronic components, lab supplies, and testing equipment. * Assist Manufacturing and Production teams with technical support during product builds. * Mentor junior technicians and provide technical guidance when needed. * Recommend improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and manufacturability. * Follow all company safety procedures and maintain a clean, organized laboratory environment. **Qualifications****Required*** Associate degree in Electronics Technology, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of hands\-on electronics technician experience. * Strong understanding of: + Analog and digital electronics + Power distribution systems + Low\-voltage electrical systems + PCB assembly and soldering + Wiring standards and cable fabrication * Experience using electronic test equipment including: + Digital Multimeters + Oscilloscopes + Power Supplies + Function Generators * Ability to read and interpret: + Electrical schematics + Wiring diagrams + Engineering drawings * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Excellent organizational and documentation skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects in a deadline\-driven environment. **Preferred Qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering Technology or related discipline. * Experience in manufacturing or custom fabrication. * Experience with: + Arduino + Raspberry Pi + PLCs + DMX lighting controls + Networking hardware + Industrial control systems + LED controllers * IPC\-A\-610 and/or IPC/WHMA\-A\-620 independently with minimal supervision. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. * Ability to adapt quickly to changing project priorities. **Physical Requirements*** Frequently lift and carry up to 50 pounds. * Stand, bend, kneel, and work at benches for extended periods. * Perform fine motor tasks requiring precision hand movements. * Distinguish wire colors and small electronic components. * Occasionally work on production floors or customer installations. **Work Environment*** Electronics laboratory and manufacturing environment. * Exposure to soldering equipment, power tools, and testing instruments. * Occasional travel to support installations or field troubleshooting. * Overtime may be required to meet project As a Senior Electronics Lab Technician, you'll work alongside engineers, fabricators, and designers to bring immersive experiences to life for some of the world's leading brands. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, building custom solutions, and seeing your work come to life, this is an exciting opportunity to make a direct impact and experiential projects to life while working alongside talented engineers, designers, and fabricators in a collaborative, hands\-on manufacturing environment.

jobs.title: Associate Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: ***\*\*\* Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC three days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT or H\-1B visa) for this role \*\*\**** Site Reliability Engineers keep the platforms behind Extra Space Storage's applications available, fast, and secure. SRE owns the AWS environments those applications run in, the pipelines that deploy them, the telemetry that proves they are healthy, and the response when they are not. This is the entry level of the SRE track. You will own scoped infrastructure and automation work inside established standards, pipelines, and runbooks, and grow into owning initiatives start to finish. You will spend more time automating operational work than performing it. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Operate and improve AWS infrastructure across a multi\-account environment, covering compute, containers, networking, databases, and identity, using infrastructure as code rather than console changes * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including reusable workflows, composite actions, and OIDC\-based deployment roles, and help migrate remaining legacy pipelines onto that platform * Instrument service level indicators and objectives in Datadog, and improve dashboards, alerting, log pipelines, and APM coverage so problems surface before customers report them * Take a full share of the team's on\-call rotation, drive incidents to restoration, and contribute to blameless postmortems and the follow\-up work they generate * Remediate security findings from sources such as Tenable, CrowdStrike, and AWS Security Hub, and own a piece of monthly patching and vulnerability work through production deployment * Automate recurring operational work such as access provisioning, credential rotation, patch cycles, and environment standup and teardown, with the goal of removing the task rather than speeding it up * Support product teams as an infrastructure partner on environment builds, deployment troubleshooting, and cost and performance questions * Write and maintain runbooks, architecture notes, and self\-service documentation so other engineering teams can move without waiting on SRE * Use AI\-assisted development and triage tooling as part of normal engineering practice, and help evaluate where it can safely reduce operational toil **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and hands\-on experience. Non\-traditional paths including bootcamps, military technical training, internal transfers, and self\-taught candidates with a demonstrable portfolio are considered. * 2\+ years of software engineering, IT operations, or infrastructure experience preferred. Internship, service desk, or systems administration experience with demonstrated automation work counts toward this. **Competencies** * Proficient in at least one language used by the team: PowerShell, Python, TypeScript, or C\#/.NET * Working knowledge of a public cloud, preferably AWS, including core compute, storage, networking, and identity services and how they fit together * Infrastructure as code experience or strong demonstrated interest (AWS CDK, CloudFormation, or Terraform), plus comfort with Git\-based workflows, pull requests, and code review * Familiarity with containers and serverless patterns (ECS/Fargate, ECR, Lambda) and with relational databases on a managed service such as RDS * Exposure to observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, or equivalent) and an instinct for what makes a system measurable * Understanding of network and security principles, including least\-privilege IAM, secrets handling, and frameworks such as CIS and OWASP * Clear written communication. Documentation, ticket updates, and incident notes are a substantial part of the job * Willingness to carry a full share of the 24/7 on\-call rotation described below, and to work occasional scheduled maintenance windows outside business hours **On\-Call** Every engineer on the team, at every level, carries an equal share of the on\-call rotation. The cycle runs in three stages: * One week as 24/7 primary, taking first response for all pages * One week as 24/7 secondary, backing up the primary and picking up escalations * Off rotation until the cycle comes back around to you **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling. Disclaimer *The job description outlines the general nature and scope of work employees perform in this role. It's not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications required for the position. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **About Flow** Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. **About the role** Flow is seeking a Solutions Architect (Sales Engineer) to be the technical partner in our sales process. Our buyers are systems and engineering leaders at aerospace, defense, automotive, and hardware companies, and they need to see how Flow fits their real workflows before they commit. You will run technical discovery, demos, and pilots, and you will be the person who can answer the hard questions in the room. This role pairs closely with our account executives. They own the commercial relationship, and you own the technical win: showing the product, mapping it to the customer's engineering process, and making sure a pilot proves out what it needs to. **What you'll do** * Partner with account executives on discovery calls, technical demos, and pilots, from first technical conversation through to a signed deal. * Understand each customer's engineering workflow and requirements process, then show how Flow fits it. * Build and run demos and proofs of concept that reflect the customer's actual use case rather than a generic script. * Answer technical and security questions from engineering, IT, and security teams, and complete security questionnaires with support from the team. * Work with product and engineering to feed back what customers need and where the product should go next. * Partner with forward deployed engineers to hand off pilots cleanly into deployment. **About you** * 4\+ years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a technical customer\-facing role. * Comfortable running a technical room, from individual engineers up to VPs, and adjusting the conversation to each. * Strong technical foundation: you can reason about APIs, integrations, and how software fits into an existing engineering stack. * Able to translate between what a customer says they need and what the product actually does. * Comfortable in a fast\-moving environment where the sales motion and the product are both still taking shape. **Nice to have** * Familiarity with requirements, systems engineering, PLM, or ALM tooling (Jama, DOORS, etc.) * Background in or selling into defense, aerospace, or regulated hardware environments. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description: **About Flow** Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. **About the role** Flow is seeking a Solutions Architect (Sales Engineer) to be the technical partner in our sales process. Our buyers are systems and engineering leaders at aerospace, defense, automotive, and hardware companies, and they need to see how Flow fits their real workflows before they commit. You will run technical discovery, demos, and pilots, and you will be the person who can answer the hard questions in the room. This role pairs closely with our account executives. They own the commercial relationship, and you own the technical win: showing the product, mapping it to the customer's engineering process, and making sure a pilot proves out what it needs to. **What you'll do** * Partner with account executives on discovery calls, technical demos, and pilots, from first technical conversation through to a signed deal. * Understand each customer's engineering workflow and requirements process, then show how Flow fits it. * Build and run demos and proofs of concept that reflect the customer's actual use case rather than a generic script. * Answer technical and security questions from engineering, IT, and security teams, and complete security questionnaires with support from the team. * Work with product and engineering to feed back what customers need and where the product should go next. * Partner with forward deployed engineers to hand off pilots cleanly into deployment. **About you** * 4\+ years in sales engineering, solutions engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a technical customer\-facing role. * Comfortable running a technical room, from individual engineers up to VPs, and adjusting the conversation to each. * Strong technical foundation: you can reason about APIs, integrations, and how software fits into an existing engineering stack. * Able to translate between what a customer says they need and what the product actually does. * Comfortable in a fast\-moving environment where the sales motion and the product are both still taking shape. **Nice to have** * Familiarity with requirements, systems engineering, PLM, or ALM tooling (Jama, DOORS, etc.) * Background in or selling into defense, aerospace, or regulated hardware environments. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

jobs.title: Senior Financial Engineer - Capital Markets
jobs.description: Playing an essential role in the U.S. economy, Fannie Mae is foundational to housing finance. Here, your expertise can help fuel purpose\-driven innovation that expands access to homeownership and affordable rental housing across the country. Join Fannie Mae to grow your career and help people find a place to call home. Job Description As a valued colleague on our team, you will develop and enhance data and analytics solutions supporting Treasury Capital Markets P\&L, capital, and return\-on\-equity reporting. You will use Python, SQL, Tableau, and, where appropriate, R to automate data pipelines and controls, build decision\-ready dashboards, investigate complex financial data, and partner with Finance and Technology teams to deliver scalable and well\-governed solutions. THE IMPACT YOU WILL MAKE The Senior Financial Engineer \- Capital Markets role will offer you the flexibility to make each day your own, while working alongside people who care so that you can deliver on the following responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain Python\- and SQL\-based data pipelines, analytical utilities, and automated validation routines for large financial datasets. Partner with Finance, Treasury, Risk, Accounting, and Technology stakeholders to translate reporting and analytical needs into technical designs, data models, and reusable solutions. Build and enhance Tableau dashboards and analytical views that explain TCM P\&L, balance, funding cost, required capital, ROE, and key performance drivers. Develop prototypes and production\-ready analytical code, including data transformations, reconciliations, exception monitoring, and scenario or attribution analysis. Translate complex data and technical findings into clear visualizations, documentation, and conclusions for technical and non\-technical audiences. Collaborate with application developers, data engineers, and financial subject\-matter experts to troubleshoot data issues, optimize queries, and improve platform performance and reliability. Perform code reviews, unit and regression testing, source\-to\-target reconciliations, data\-quality checks, release validation, and production support for internally developed tools and dashboards. THE EXPERIENCE YOU BRING TO THE TEAM Minimum Required Experiences: 2 years of experience developing data, analytics, automation, or reporting solutions in a finance, risk, or capital markets environment. Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, data profiling, query optimization, and working with large datasets. Hands\-on experience using Python for data analysis, automation, ETL, validation, or analytical application development. Experience developing and supporting Tableau dashboards, including data connections, calculated fields, performance tuning, and validation of data and visual outputs. Experience with software development practices such as version control, modular code, documentation, testing, peer review, and controlled releases. Shows curiosity and adaptability in learning and responsibly applying new technologies, including artificial intelligence, to reimagine how we work. **Desired Experiences:** Bachelor degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Financial Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience with R for statistical analysis, modeling, or data transformation is preferred but not required. Knowledge of AWS, Redshift, data warehousing, APIs, ETL frameworks, or cloud\-based analytics platforms. Knowledge of accounting P\&L, capital markets products, mortgage finance, funds transfer pricing, required capital, or ROE concepts. Experience implementing data\-quality controls, monitoring, reconciliation frameworks, and production support for business\-critical reporting. Capital Markets CFO \- Financial Engineering \- Senior Associate **Target Pay Range:** $109,000 \- $142,000 a year \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-ME1 ​ Qualifications **Education:** Bachelor's Level Degree (Required) The future is what you make it to be. jobs.title: Principal National Support Engineer II
jobs.description: Position Overview: The Principal National Support Engineer II provides the highest level of technical expertise and experience to the Fujifilm Healthcare Medical Informatics business covering all currently offered products including, but not limited to: storage systems, PACS (Radiology/Cardiology), VNA, Mobility, 3D Systems, Syncomm and Clinical Information Systems. While this position primarily supports the Technical Assistance Center (TAC), technical leadership and direction is provided to all other functional departments within the business including development. In some cases, support is also provided to the modality side of the business as well. The Principal National Support Engineer II will assist in driving all aspects of customer support related issues that are mostly technical in nature, although system administration and clinical support is provided utilizing the escalation process. The Principal National Support Engineer II will evaluate, triage, present and work in concert with development to ensure optimal customer experience and timely resolution to high priority issues. Additionally, the Principal National Support Engineer II is tasked with documenting all activities associated with an issue and providing communications (service bulletins, procedures, etc.) to the TAC, Project Engineering and Upgrade teams and in some cases directly to the customer. As needed, training is to be provided by the Principal National Support Engineer II to the various technical (in some cases) non\-technical areas on new software/product releases. The Principal National Support Engineer II is also tasked with leading support issues to resolution being seen at customers site and work directly with development by functioning as a dedicated technical liaison. In addition, the Principal National Support Engineer II will provide after\-hours technical support via the On\-call process for down\-site situations 24/7\. Company Overview: At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting\-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in\-vitro diagnostics. But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non\-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly. Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive. Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers Job Description: **Duties and Responsibilities:*** Lead major incident resolution efforts, taking ownership of the most critical customer cases end\-to\-end. * Act as a designated Subject Matter Expert (SME) for specific product areas, providing advanced guidance to peers and junior engineers. * Deep Technical Individual Contributor: Expert troubleshooter and primary interface for complex escalations, mastering 3 core product lines and able to effectively support a minimum of 1 or more of other products offered by Fuji. * Proactively mentor and guide junior technical support engineers, contributing to their technical development. * Tasked with providing advanced technical training to the TAC, Upgrade and Project Engineer team members. * Tasked with the review and triaging of escalations received from TAC for domestic customers, present this issue to development, and work with development until resolution. * Tasked with the review and triaging of escalations received from International Partners, presenting the issue to development, and works with development until resolution. * Work in concert with TAC and/or directly with domestic customers as needed until resolution. * Work in concert with TAC and/or directly with International Partners as needed until resolution. * Works directly with development on special projects, new software/product releases or as needed. * Tasked with communicating clinically related issues to development. * As needed, drive technical issues directly with customers. * When requested, assist the marketing and sales teams is responding to technically related questions presented in Request for Proposal (RFP) received to win new business opportunities. * Operates with minimal managerial supervision, while being driven through self\-motivation and driving issues to completion. * Engages immediately upon request from TAC on issues with high visibility customers a stry certifications. * Maintain and expand the expert knowledge of their current primary product line and future releases. * Continue in driving and working issues within development until resolution. * Provide advanced technical knowledge Lead National Support Engineer and other parts of the organization including (but not limited to) TAC, PE, and UE teams. * Create, review and publish applicable documentation in timely fashion. * Respond to escalation requests within the response times identified in the approved escalation process. * Conduct training to other parts of the organization via virtual meeting and/or in person training classes. **Qualifications:*** Masters (preferred) with 6 years industry experience or Bachelor’s Degree with industry experience of 8 years or comparable work experience of 10 \+ years of industry experience. * Leading Industry Certifications, not limited to: * Security Certification (Security \+ or higher). * Current VCP Certification. * VCP certification. * CISCO Certification. * Oracle Certification. * Microsoft Certification. * AWS Certification. * Minimum ten (10\) years of progressive experience as a Technical, Systems, Software or Quality Assurance Engineer in Medical IT and/or Imaging products. **Physical Requirements:** The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:* The ability to sit up 75\-100% of applicable work time. * The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time. * The ability to stand, talk, and listen for 75% of applicable work time. * This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, crouching, and/or crawling under a desk. * Ability to be able to lift and/or move items that weigh up to 50 pounds frequently. * Able to reach above their head to work on equipment that is on a desk, on the floor, or a server rack within a datacenter. * Ability to type and have the manual dexterity to manipulate hand tools such as screwdrivers, pliers, wrenches, etc. **Travel:*** Occasional (up to 25%) travel may be required based on business need. **Salary and Benefits:*** $110,366\-$130,909 * Medical, Dental, Vision * Life Insurance * 401k * Paid Time Off * \#LI\-Remote *In the event that COVID\-19 vaccine mandates issued by the federal government, or by state or local government become effective and enforceable, the jobs.title: Power Systems Services Specialist
jobs.description: At GE Vernova, we don’t just look at the energy grid—we evolve it. We are the architects of a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable future. By joining our team, you become part of a global force solving the world’s most complex energy challenges. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of technology to accelerate the energy transition and empower communities, your journey starts here. Are you ready to shape the future of the power grid? As a Lead Power Systems Services Specialist, you will serve as a key member of our Software Center of Excellence, designing and delivering advanced applications that power the world’s Electric Utilities and ISOs. From Distribution Management Systems (DMS) to Dispatcher Training Simulators (DTS), your work will directly enhance grid reliability and operational efficiency. We are looking for a technical visionary who thrives on solving complex engineering problems, collaborating across teams, and delivering high\-quality, mission\-critical software that keeps the lights on. **Job Description** =================== **Roles and Responsibilities** * Act as a member in Software Center of Excellence, representing the face of high\-quality design and development practices. Implement new functionalities in power system application software which includes DMS (Distribution Management System), DTS (Dispatcher Training Simulator) and Modeling (EMS/DTS/Oil and Gas and Distribution) applications. * Provide maintenance of power systems application functionality; including code fixes, documentation, and user interfaces. * Collaborate with system/project engineers, frontend developers and Distribution Management System (DMS) application developers to implement solutions that are aligned with product direction. * Consults with other technical leads to ensure that project\-related system design guidelines are being followed. Responsible for writing DMS Functional Software Designs. * Provides input to technical lead on schedules and cost estimates. * Interfaces with customers on general and specific issues within area of functional expertise. * Provides marketing support for proposals and demonstrations to potential customers. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Power Systems or a STEM major with at least 5 years of development or project delivery experience, OR * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a STEM major with at least 3 years of development or project delivery experience. **Desired Characteristics** * Work and/or academic experience in the power systems area. Distribution and Outage Management System. * Excellent programming skills in C\+\+, Java or other related language, as required. Knowledge on Perl, PowerShell and SQL (MSSQL and/or T\-SQL) scripting languages. Good understanding of database operation. * Good understanding of power systems and/or energy management systems with focus on Distribution Network Applications like Power flow, Fault Location, Isolation and Service Restoration, Load and Volt Var Management and Distribution Operator training Simulator. * Knowledge and experience with electric utility industry practices * Ability to see integration issues and to preclude schedule impacts. * Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to write professional and technical reports and procedures. Ability to make formal and informal presentation to technical and non\-technical staff and customers. * Ability to work independently and be self\-motivated. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment. * Ability to travel and work at customer site, based on the project demands. \#LI\-SG1 GE Vernova offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE Vernova is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. GE Vernova will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable). **Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes \#LI\-Remote \- This is a remote position For candidates applying to a U.S. based position, the pay range for this position is between $104,000\.00 and $156,000\.00\. The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus. This posting is expected to remain open for at least seven days after it was posted on September 17, 2026\. Available benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to Health Coach from GE Vernova, a 24/7 nurse\-based resource; and access to the Employee Assistance Program, providing 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Vernova Retirement Savings Plan, a tax\-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and financial planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability benefits, life insurance, 12 paid holidays, and permissive time off. jobs.title: Senior Staff Applied Research Scientist
jobs.description: **Why Join GEICO?** At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities. Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide. Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers. **Job Title: Senior Staff** **Applied****Research****Scientist** We are seeking a Senior Staff Applied Research Scientist with profound expertise to drive the direction, vision, and architectural standards for enterprise\-scale AI/ML initiatives. As a self\-directed technical leader within GEICO’s AI Research team, you will architect and deliver innovative AI/ML solutions that span multiple business domains, define the future of insurance operations, and accelerate transformation across the company. You will set technical strategy, mentor scientists and engineers at all levels, and partner closely with senior leadership to align AI investments with measurable business outcomes. **Key Responsibilities:** * Drive the Direction and Vision of AI/ML Initiatives: Define and own the technical strategy and long\-term roadmap for cross\-functional AI/ML programs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and scalable, robust, and compliant delivery. * Identify High\-Impact Opportunities: Surface and shape high\-value AI use cases through deep engagement with product, engineering, data, and business leaders; translate ambiguous needs into actionable ML problem statements and investment cases. * Architecture and Technical Leadership: Architect end\-to\-end AI/ML systems spanning data acquisition, feature engineering, model development, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring across online and batch environments. Establish standards for scalability, reliability, observability, security, compliance, and cost efficiency. * Development and Productionization: Lead the full lifecycle of model development from concept to production, including rapid prototyping, A/B testing, causal inference, and continuous improvement with clear delivery plans and milestones. * ROI Measurement and Experimentation: Establish rigorous KPI frameworks, experimentation strategies, and causal analysis to quantify business impact, prioritize investments, and guide decision\-making for portfolio\-level initiatives. * Innovation and Research Integration: Stay current with cutting\-edge ML/AI research. Prototype and translate novel techniques into hardened, scalable solutions within GEICO’s insurance ecosystem. * Define company\-level research strategy and investment priorities; cultivate external collaborations (academia/industry) and guide the IP portfolio aligned to high\-impact insurance outcomes. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Drive collaboration across Product, Engineering, Data Platform, Governance, Legal, Security, and Operations to ensure responsible, reliable, and effective AI adoption. * Mentorship and Capability Building: Mentor Applied research scientists and engineers, elevate technical standards, and cultivate a culture of scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and continuous learning. * Presentations and Executive Engagement: Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences. Present to senior leadership, setting context, explaining trade\-offs, and building alignment and enthusiasm for AI/ML initiatives. * Evangelism and Thought Leadership: Champion the transformative role of AI/ML across GEICO by speaking at internal forums, contributing to leadership discussions, and setting high standards that influence practices beyond your immediate team. * Strategic and Cultural Leadership: Contribute to the overarching strategy, roadmap, and operating model for AI/ML at GEICO. Foster a culture of craftsmanship, innovation, accountability, and excellence. **Qualifications:** * B.S. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, PhD is preferred. * Minimum of 8 years of professional experience delivering applied AI/ML solutions in production, with a proven record of leading end\-to\-end model development and cross\-functional initiatives with enterprise impact. * Deep theoretical and practical expertise in statistical learning, machine learning, deep learning, and large language models; ability to reason from first principles and select appropriate methods under real\-world constraints. * Demonstrated experience establishing KPI frameworks, experimentation strategies, and causal analysis to quantify model impact and inform prioritization. * Research experience in computer sc lated fields; record of patents, publications, or impactful open\-source contributions. * Proven ability to mentor and lead senior research scientists and engineers; establish and enforce high standards for code quality, testing, documentation, and reproducibility. * Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence senior executives and drive alignment across product, engineering, and business functions. * Extensive experience with Python and SQL; deep hands\-on expertise with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit\-learn. * Ability to solve complex technical challenges and craft long\-term strategic visions that scale across teams and business areas. **Preferred Skills:** * Advanced modeling experience in numerical optimization, NLP, LLMs, and reinforcement learning; familiarity with evaluation strategies, guardrails, prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), red\-teaming, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows. * Expertise in building domain\-specific benchmarks and evaluation suites (including for GenAI/LLMs and safety), and in establishing ethical research practices and data governance suited to regulated environments. * Experience with responsible AI, model governance, and risk management in regulated environments; familiarity with insurance operations is a plus. **Work Locations**: Candidates must be open to the following locations: * Bethesda, Maryland * Palo Alto, CA * New York City, NY * Seattle, WA This is a unique opportunity to shape the architectural direction of AI at GEICO, define and deliver transformative AI/ML solutions at enterprise scale, and mentor the next generation of Applied research scientists. If you are passionate about driving innovation, measurable business impact, and a culture of excellence, we encourage you to apply. **Annual Salary** $150,000\.00 \- $300,000\.00 The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. GEICO will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. **The GEICO Pledge:** **Great Company:** Protecting customers through life’s twists and turns with innovation and integrity. **Great Careers:**Personalized development programs, mentorship, and certification assistance. **Great Culture:**Inclusive and collaborative culture rooted in shared success. **Great Rewards:**Competitive pay, benefits, and flexibility to support your well\-being and future. The equal employment opportunity policy of the GEICO Companies provides for a fair and equal employment opportunity for all associates and job applicants regardless of race, color, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law. GEICO hires and promotes individuals solely on the basis of their qualifications for the job to be filled. GEICO reasonably accommodates qualified individuals with disabilities to enable them to receive equal employment opportunity and/or perform the essential functions of the job, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship to the Company. This applies to all applicants and associates. GEICO also provides a work environment in which each associate is able to be productive and work to the best of their ability. We do not condone or tolerate an atmosphere of intimidation or harassment. We expect and require the cooperation of all associates in maintaining an atmosphere free from discrimination and harassment with mutual respect by and for all associates and applicants.

jobs.description: **Job Description** *At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. As Principal Software Engineer, you are the senior technical authority and system architect for that layer — you'll determine which platform problems matter most, then define the architecture and drive the solutions that solve them, setting long\-term direction for virtualization, partitioning, and platform services across GM's vehicle compute. Your influence extends well past your own code: establishing the technical interfaces to the silicon, guest OS, and functional\-safety organizations, driving decisions with hypervisor and silicon partners, and guiding engineers across multiple teams toward a foundation that must hold up to production performance, reliability, and safety requirements in millions of vehicles. **What** **You’ll** **Do** * Define and drive the architecture and long\-term roadmap for GM’s Core OS layer, including hypervisors, virtualization, virtual machine lifecycle, resource partitioning, inter\-virtual\-machine communication, and the boot and secure\-boot chain. * Architect the multi\-operating\-system foundation that enables embedded Linux, including Yocto\-based distributions, Android, and QNX to run on shared vehicle compute with consistent platform services and interfaces. * Establish the platform safety architecture, including freedom from interference between partitions, health monitoring, fault detection and recovery, in partnership with functional safety and cybersecurity organizations. * Define the container and workload\-management architecture for on\-vehicle execution, including isolation, lifecycle management, resource governance, and updateability. * Own the system\-level performance strategy across compute efficiency, latency, boot time, memory footprint, and deterministic behavior, and lead optimization efforts across software and hardware boundaries. * Drive build\-versus\-buy and technology\-selection decisions for hypervisor, real\-time operating system, and runtime components, and lead technical relationships with the corresponding suppliers. * Provide technical mentorship and direction to Staff and Senior Software Engineers while establishing engineering standards and review practices for the new organization. * Lead complex investigations and root\-cause analyses across virtualization, operating\-system , and silicon boundaries. Represent Core OS in technical councils, architecture reviews, and cross\-functional design forums, and define ownership boundaries with adjacent platform teams. **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required
