jobs.title: Connectivity Engineer - Data Center Design, Engineering, & Construction
jobs.description: Meta is seeking a Connectivity Engineer to join the Design Engineering and Construction (DEC) team. Our data centers are the foundation upon which our services are delivered, and our rapidly scaling infrastructure operates. The team lights up Meta ’s global data centers, delivering the physical infrastructure that connects the world to the videos, feeds, and other information stored on Meta ’s server banks.The DEC Connectivity Engineer will provide site level support to ensure DEC telecommunication projects are being executed on schedule, within budget and at the level of quality specified. Connectivity Engineer will be the key point of contact for managing the full project life\-cycle including project kick\-off all the way through production turnover into operations. DEC Connectivity Engineer is highly collaborative with cross\-functional partners at the Data Center Headquarters, our on\-site contractor, and other data centers globally. ### **Connectivity Engineer \- Data Center Design, Engineering, \& Construction Responsibilities:** * Project Planning \& Control \- Create, maintain, and report on site project and program scope, schedules and milestones. Work closely with site project management team throughout the project lifecycle from the creation of project and program plans through project close out * Learnings \- Continually review ongoing projects for efficiencies in schedule, budget, and opportunities to enable cross\-functional partners to be successful. Document data points to assist with field coordination of projects. Support development of project management best practices and initiatives, coordinating SOPs/SIPs with vendors, and participating in global and regional standards. Coordinate lessons learned with the internal and external cross functional partners * Forecasting \- Support project controls team with forecasting and budget efforts as required. Share current project status with upstream and downstream partners, ensuring crisp and complete handoffs between teams * Technical Reviews \- Establish milestones for equipment purchase and track and report against these milestones Assist with the selection and review of a contractor to support the structured cabling work within a data center * Metrics \- Report progress and risks on site projects and other initiatives to key stakeholders * Workflow \- Work with installation partners to establish and track milestones. Conduct pre\-project planning, project handoffs, and ensure design delivery and verification. Identify and respond to project risks and high\-priority issues rapidly and effectively through effective action and appropriate escalation. Track and manage project change order requests * Vendor Field Management \- Responsible for all connectivity activities within construction, projects on site including tracking and reporting actual progress related to schedule expectations. Set and communicate clear expectations together with the immediate site team, build key relationships with our installation partners, foster a safe, collaborative working environment and execute a goal of ‘right first time.’ * Quality Assurance \- Perform physical inspections to ensure vendor work meets DEC quality standards throughout the lifecycle of the data center. Validate physical installs, test reports, build accuracy, material and local code compliance including constructability reviews on multiple design phases * Technical Field Lead \- Technical lead for industry and Meta standards, responsible to lead product evaluation, design, and installation methods in the field including scope clarification, design and installation details as the owner of the Request for Information process * Technical Coordination \- Develop solutions to in\-field scope\-gap or clash issues. Partner with DEC design and engineering teams to digitally support design reviews, BOM reviews, and as\-built drawing validations * Communications \& Cross functional team engagement \- Liaise with construction partners to ensure deliverables are met during new builds and retrofits. Coordinate with logistics partners, vendors, and suppliers to ensure a smooth end to end flow of materials as needed. Work closely with the relevant teams to proactively communicate progress and project risks and initiatives to key stakeholders * Safety \- Ensure that vendors adhere to safety obligations in accordance with local regulations and DEC Safety best practices. Lead a 'safety first' experience while working with others, in support of shared goals. Foster an environment of open and transparent communication while acknowledging demonstrated experience in EHS practices ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * 7\+ years experience in project management * Experience engaging and guiding stakeholders * Experience providing solutions to construction related problems * Experience with MS Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and MS Project ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience reviewing and leading installations to design documents and specifications * Data center development and/or construction management experience. * Experience with Quality Assurance and Quality Control, including progressive inspections and acceptance. * Experience in leading deployments of Network/Structure cabling infrastructure. * Experience with fiber optic testing at scale inclusive of complex troubleshooting. * Experience with outside plant cabling (OSP) deployments including OTDR/OLTS testing. * Experience managing IT or IP Network deployment projects in a mission critical environment requiring coordination across multiple disciplines for the delivery of a common goal. * Experience with Primavera 6\. * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics. Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E\-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment. Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations\-ext@meta.com. $123,000/year to $176,000/year \+ bonus \+ equity \+ benefits Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

jobs.title: Assistant Engineer I
jobs.description: Job Overview: At the Metropolitan Water District of Southern California, we deliver reliable water to a region with 19 million people—and to accomplish this, we rely on a team of talented employees: innovators, problem\-solvers, and collaborators who make it all possible. There **is** currently **1** openingfor **Assistant Engineer I** located at Headquarters, Los Angeles CA. This recruitment may result in an eligibility list\*. As an Assistant Engineer in the Power Operations \& Planning section of the Integrated Operations Planning \& Support Services group you will learn from experienced professionals while assisting with engineering studies, technical analyses, project planning, field inspections, and the preparation of technical documents. This is an opportunity to gain hands\-on experience, develop your engineering skills, and contribute to meaningful projects in a collaborative team environment. **What You’ll Do** * Learns and assists with planning, coordinating, and supporting engineering projects related to Metropolitan’s bulk electric power systems such as transmission lines, substations, generators, bulk energy storage systems (BESS), large commercial and industrial loads, and other similar works. * Learns and assists with performing engineering analyses using industry\-standard power system analytical software suites (e.g. GE\-PSLF, Powerworld, Aspen One\-Liner, etc.) and applying mathematical, statistical, and computational methods to evaluate data and support technical solutions. * Learns and assists with preparing technical reports, correspondence, presentations, plans, and other engineering documentation using industry\-standard software suites (e.g. Microsoft Office, Excel, Powerpoint, Adobe, etc). * Learns and assists with interpreting applicable bulk electric system reliability compliance standards, developing and implementing a compliance assurance program, and using industry\-standard methodologies to document annual compliance obligations. * Learns and assists with maintaining accurate project records, engineering documents, databases, and other official records in accordance with established procedures. * Learns and assists with keeping abreast of developments regarding AI, particularly with regards to the electric utility industry, and assisting in using machine learning tools to streamline workflows and improve bulk electric system reliability and efficiency. This job announcement has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this classification / job. To view the full job description, click here: **Assistant Engineer I** **Schedule:** 9/80, Monday through Friday with every other Friday off. Monday through Thursday 9 hours per day, 8 hours per day every other Friday. Start times are no earlier than 6 am and end times are no later than 6 pm. **Hybrid:** Metropolitan’s current practice in this position is a hybrid work schedule. This typically includes two days a week in person and the other days remote. This is subject to change dependent on organizational needs. In addition, a telework policy is scheduled for negotiations and once completed and implemented, will provide final direction on the hybrid schedule. **EMPLOYMENT STANDARDS MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a related field by hired date. **Related degree is defined as:** Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Science/Computer Engineering. **CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, AND REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS** **License(s):** Valid California Class C Driver’s License or equivalent (required at time of application) that allows you to drive during your employment. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation * Excellent medical, dental, life, vision plans. * Deferred compensation in the form of a 401(k) plan (with matching contribution) and a 457 plan. * Retirement benefits under the California Public Employees' Retirement System * Tuition reimbursement * Training and advancement opportunities * Public transportation reimbursements * Hub of public transportation: rail, subway, buses, and taxis * On\-site fitness center For more information on MWD benefits, please use the following link: **Benefits Regular FT PT Employees (Represented)** **ABOUT MWD** The Metropolitan Water District of Southern California is a state\-established cooperative that, along with its 26 cities and retail suppliers, provides water for 19 million people in six counties. The district imports water from the Colorado River and Northern California to supplement local supplies, and helps its members to develop increased water conservation, recycling, storage and other resource\-management programs. Metropolitan is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. The Metropolitan Water District of Southern California is committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees. Qualified individuals with disabilities who need a reasonable accommodation during the application or selection process, please reach out to the Human Resources Office at (213\) 217\-7738 or email jobs@mwdh2o.com. If you require a religious accommodation during the application, interview, or employment process, please reach out to the EEO Office at (213\) 217\-5858 or eeooffice@mwdh2o.com. Requests are evaluated on a case\-by\-case basis. Metropolitan is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic(s). **Application Filing Period:** Closes at 11:59 pm PST on the date stated in the job announcement. However it may close prior to the filing end date if sufficient applications have been received. jobs.title: Data Center Technician L3
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed. **Job Overview** ---------------- Data Center Technician L3 **Job Overview** ---------------- The Data Center Technician L3 is an advanced, hands\-on role supporting the build\-out and ongoing operation of a high\-performance, enterprise\-scale data center environment supporting advanced compute and large\-scale infrastructure deployments. This position is designed for experienced technicians who are comfortable owning complex tasks and serving as a primary technical escalation point within the site. You will play a key role during the initial deployment phase, contributing to hardware installation, structured cabling, and infrastructure bring\-up. As the data center transitions into steady\-state operations, you will take on increased responsibility for troubleshooting, incident response, and operational execution. You will work across server, network, and infrastructure domains, collaborating closely with engineers and site leadership to maintain uptime and performance. This role requires strong technical capability, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced production environment. You will collaborate with cross\-functional teams, making clear and professional communication in English (written and verbal) essential for success in this role. This role offers continuity across both deployment and operational phases, providing exposure to large\-scale infrastructure environments and a clear path for progression into advanced technical or engineering roles. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Perform rack \& stack, hardware installation, and structured cabling during deployment phase * Support system provisioning, configuration, and validation activities * Troubleshoot infrastructure issues across Layer 1–3 (hardware, cabling, and network) * Serve as a primary technical escalation point for complex operational issues * Interface with network devices via CLI (Cisco, Arista, Juniper, Dell) * Utilize Linux systems for troubleshooting and operational support * Maintain accurate asset and inventory records using ITSM/DCIM tools * Participate in change management, including maintenance windows and production changes * Support transition from deployment to steady\-state operations, including documentation and process adherence * Ensure compliance with safety, security, and operational standards * Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, including process optimization and operational efficiency initiatives * Participate in on\-call rotation supporting 24x7 operations **Required Skills** ------------------- * Strong English communication skills (written and verbal) are required for coordination with cross\-functional teams * Advanced hands\-on experience with data center hardware, cabling, and infrastructure environments * Proficiency with Linux systems for troubleshooting and basic scripting tasks * Ability to configure and troubleshoot network hardware using CLI tools * Strong understanding of hardware lifecycle management (installation, maintenance, decommissioning) * Experience working within structured operational processes (SOPs, change management, ticketing systems) * Familiarity with ITSM/DCIM platforms (ServiceNow, Jira, or similar) * Strong cable management and structured cabling skills (fiber and copper) * Ability to read and follow technical documentation, diagrams, and procedures * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Ability to multitask and adapt in a fast\-paced environment * Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently when needed **Physical \& Operational Requirements** ---------------------------------------- * Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs * Comfortable working on feet for extended periods * Ability to respond to on\-call incidents within defined timelines * Ability to reliably commute to the work location * Ability to operate material handling equipment (certification preferred) **Required Experience** ----------------------- * 4\+ years of experience in data center operations or similar technical environments * Proven experience with rack \& stack, hardware installation, and structured cabling * Experience provisioning and re\-provisioning systems (USB, PXE, or network\-based methods) * Experience bootstrapping network devices and configuring IP addressing * Working knowledge of Linux systems and basic scripting (e.g., Bash, Ansible) * Experience supporting enterprise server hardware (Dell, HPE, Supermicro, or similar) * Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, Layer 2/3 concepts) * Experience working within ticketing systems (Jira preferred) * Knowledge of data center best practices (redundancy, fault tolerance, cabling standards) * Basic understanding of electrical, HVAC, and infrastructure systems **Preferred Certifications** ---------------------------- * CompTIA Server\+, Network\+, or equivalent * ITIL Foundation * CCNA or similar networking certification **Compensation** ---------------- Estimated Pay Range: Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location. **Our Commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion** -------------------------------------------- *At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.* *Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.* *We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self\-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*

jobs.title: Mobile Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mosai** Mosai™ is the intelligent care coordination platform that brings together the fragmented pieces of healthcare into a clear, connected picture. Like a mosaic, our platform unites data, people, and processes so providers can make better decisions, coordinate care in real time, and deliver improved outcomes. With Mosai, home\-based care organizations can thrive in value\-based care while giving every patient the right care, in the right place, at the right time. Learn more at https://www.mosai.com/ **Position Summary** Mosai is seeking a mid\-to\-senior Mobile Software Engineer to build and evolve Mosai Mobile, the iOS and Android application clinicians use in the field. You will deliver reliable, intuitive features that help home\-based care teams document care, coordinate work, and remain productive when connectivity is limited or unavailable. The ideal candidate is a strong React Native engineer who enjoys end\-to\-end ownership, collaborates effectively with Product and QA, and can contribute to native iOS and Android code when needed. **Job Duties:** * Help evolve an AI\-native software development lifecycle by using AI\-assisted tools for planning, implementation, testing, documentation, code review, and troubleshooting. * Identify practical opportunities to improve development velocity and quality through AI\-enabled workflows, while maintaining strong engineering judgment and appropriate human review. * Design, build, test, and release features for Mosai Mobile using React Native, Expo, and TypeScript. * Own work across the mobile client, including user interface, application state, API integrations, and local data storage. * Build for reliability in real\-world field conditions, including offline workflows, synchronization, error handling, retries, and app store releases. * Contribute to native iOS and Android code when a feature requires platform\-specific capabilities beyond JavaScript. * Use AI coding assistants as part of the development workflow while maintaining responsibility for the quality, security, privacy, and correctness of released software. * Write and maintain automated tests, participate in code reviews, and help improve engineering standards. * Partner closely with Product, Design, QA, and backend engineering to deliver high\-quality mobile experiences. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools effectively as part of the software development lifecycle, with accountability for code quality, security, privacy, and correctness. * Five or more years of software engineering experience, including at least three years building and shipping React Native applications for both iOS and Android. * Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and React Native. * Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs. * Ability to read, debug, and contribute to Swift and/or Kotlin code. * Strong product judgment and the ability to translate user needs into clear, well\-designed mobile experiences. * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools, such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude, and an interest in using them thoughtfully and effectively. * Strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently in a collaborative environment. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Experience helping teams adopt or improve AI\-native engineering practices, including AI\-assisted testing, code review, documentation, and developer workflows. * Experience with Redux or comparable state\-management solutions. * Experience building offline\-first mobile applications, including camera, image, and document\-capture workflows. * Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines and releasing applications through the Apple App Store and Google Play. * Experience in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated SaaS environment. **Physical Demands of Our Work Environment** * This position uses a computer and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The in\-office noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Frequent interruptions may be encountered throughout the workday. * The employee is required to either stand or sit, talk and hear frequently required to use repetitive keying or hand motions. * The physical demands are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Mosai is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status, If you are unable to submit an application because of a incompatible assistive technology or disability, please contact us at careers@mosai.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for disability assistance as soon as possible. Mosai is an E\-verify employer. Your eligibility to work in the United States will be verified through the E\-verify system if you apply and are selected for a position.

jobs.description: **Position Description** ------------------------ **Open until filled** **Priority Screening:****Thursday, August 27, 2026** **Exam:** **26/41C14/08GM** **Associate Water Resources Hydrologist** $9,332 – $12,746 Monthly The County of Monterey is committed to honoring the service and sacrifice of veterans and eligible military spouses and awards veterans’ preference points for this recruitment. To learn more about the eligibility requirements and the process, be sure to read the **Hiring Preference for Veterans and Eligible Military Spouses** section located towards the end of this job flier. The Monterey County Water Resources Agency (MCWRA or Agency) is an independent, special purpose public agency staffed with dedicated employees and focused on water resources management in Monterey County. The Agency was created via a California Water Code Appendix in a statute known as the Monterey County Water Resources Agency Act. The Agency is governed by the Monterey County Water Resources Agency Board of Supervisors for larger policy matters and a nine\-member Board of Directors for more in\-depth oversight. The Agency provides the following services: control of flood and storm waters, flood warning and monitoring, water conservation, protection of water quality, reclamation of water and the exchange of water. Fundamental to the Agency’s mission to sustainably manage water resources while minimizing impacts from flooding, the MCWRA owns and operates the Nacimiento and San Antonio reservoirs and dams, a hydroelectric facility at Nacimiento Reservoir, the Salinas River Diversion Facility, the Castroville Seawater Intrusion Project, the Salinas Valley Reclamation Project, various drainage facilities, and numerous wells. MCWRA executes long\-term groundwater and surface water monitoring programs throughout the Salinas Valley Groundwater Basin and provides technical expertise on water resource management and planning throughout Monterey County. **The Position:** MCWRA seeks qualified candidates to fill two Associate Water Resources Hydrologist vacancies: one in the Operations section and one in the Hydrology and Environmental Resources section. This position is responsible for supervising assigned program functional activities and professional and technical level personnel. The candidate must perform a variety of complex hydrologic and hydrogeologic assignments and projects that include overseeing aspects of the operations and evaluation of the reservoir release program, flood warning system and other programs related to MCWRA facilities, and the groundwater monitoring program. The ideal candidates will demonstrate integrity; flexibility and adaptability; be able to navigate complex situations with professionalism and poise; be able to communicate technical and policy information effectively to diverse audiences; and be organized and efficient to complete multiple projects concurrently. This candidate must be able to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment, seek multi\-benefit solutions for new and ongoing projects or programs, and demonstrate good independent judgment. The ideal candidate for the position in the Operations Section will have a strong background in the operation of water resource\-related facilities such as dams, reservoirs, water diversion structures, or flood conveyance systems; flood warning systems; water rights compliance and reporting; and project and grant management. The ideal candidate for the position in the Hydrology and Environmental Resources section will have a strong background in groundwater and surface water data collection methodologies, equipment, and industry best practices; data management and monitoring network evaluation; and analysis and reporting of complex datasets. *The Eligible List established by this recruitment may be used to fill current and future vacancies on a regular full\-time, part\-time, or temporary basis County\-wide.* **Examples of Duties** ---------------------- **Examples of duties:** * Supervises and participates in the work of professional hydrology staff responsible for the planning, design, development, operation and maintenance of the department or agency capital improvement projects and programs including flood control, surface and groundwater quality and water supply, storage, treatment and distribution facilities and systems; ensures work quality and adherence to professional codes, standards and department or agency specifications; may provide supervision over assigned maintenance or operations functions. * Counsels employees, appraises performance, prepares documentation, recommends merit increases, and issues discipline; provides for or participates in employee training and development; conducts interviews and recommends selection of candidates; coaches and mentors subordinate staff. * Performs the more complex, difficult and large scale hydrologic and hydrogeologic planning, specification, feasibility analysis and calculations for water resour  include, but are not limited to the following: * Possess a valid California Class C driver license at the time of appointment and possess and maintain a satisfactory driving record or provide evidence of suitable transportation which is approved by the appointing authority. * Be available to work a flexible schedule, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and during times of disaster and/or emergency; travel out of County to attend meetings. * Depending on assignment, may need to demonstrate the ability to swim safely for 50 yards in order to safely work on and around large bodies of water. **BENEFITS:** Monterey County offers an excellent benefits package. Alisal Street, 3rd Floor Salinas, CA 93901 **SELECTION PROCESS:** The selection process is tentative, and applicants will be notified if changes are made. To assess applicants' possession of required qualifications, the examination process may include an oral examination, pre\-examination exercises, performance examination, and/or written examination. The competitive examination process includes submittal of required application materials. Resumes, cover letters, letters of interest, and other correspondence will not be accepted as a substitute for required application materials. All required application materials will be competitively evaluated. Those applicants that are determined to be the most appropriately qualified will be invited to participate further in the selection process. **HIRING PREFERENCE FOR VETERANS AND ELIGIBLE MILITARY SPOUSES** The County of Monterey is committed to honoring the service and sacrifice of veterans and eligible military spouses (i.e., surviving spouses of veterans, spouses of totally disabled veterans, and spouses of active\-duty service members) and awards veterans’ preference points for this recruitment. Initially, you'll lead the day\-to\-day operations of our Datacenter Infrastructure team, ensuring our on\-premise environments operate with a high degree of reliability, security, and scalability. Observability, Reliability \& Incident Management * Establish and maintain observability standards and practices across infrastructure and cloud environments in partnership with key stakeholders. * Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring, telemetry, and operational visibility are incorporated into infrastructure and application environments. * Provide leadership for incident response subject matter TO organization, particularly with Engineering, Architecture, and Cloud Operations leadership. * Serve as an operational liaison between Cloud Operations and product engineering teams. * Ensure the team is appropriately embedded with engineering organizations to contribute to roadmap planning and execution. * Develop the team into trusted advisors to other Cloud Operations functions and engineering stakeholders. * Support strategic planning, budgeting, capacity planning, and investment decisions for the organization. **What You'll Need to Be Successful** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 12\+ years of professional experience in cloud or infrastructure engineering and operations, preferably within a SaaS environment. * 6\+ years of people leadership experience, including demonstrated success leading teams through significant changes in technical direction, capabilities, or operating models. * Hands\-on or operational experience with physical datacenter environments, including hardware lifecycle, facilities, networking, and compute infrastructure. * Working knowledge of AWS PaaS services, including technologies such as ECS/Fargate, DocumentDB, MSK, Valkey, and SES. * Experience operating across both traditional infrastructure and public cloud environments. * Experience implementing automation and DevOps practices within production operations environments. * Demonstrated project and change management experience within a multinational organization. * Experience with strategic planning, budgeting, and financial management. * Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001\. **What Will Make You Stand Out** * Experience leading an infrastructure organization through a significant datacenter\-to\-public\-cloud transformation. * Experience developing infrastructure engineers into cloud or platform engineers. * Experience operating AWS PaaS services supporting large\-scale SaaS applications. * Experience partnering directly with product engineering teams in an embedded or shared\-responsibility operating model. * Experience building mature observability, incident response, business continuity, or disaster recovery programs. * Experience operating infrastructure for enterprise SaaS products in highly regulated or security\-conscious environments. **What You'll Love About NetDocuments** * The People! * 90% healthcare premiums company covered * HSA company contribution * 401K match at 4% with immediate vesting * Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year) * 10 paid holidays * Monthly contributions for life activities \& wellness * Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore * Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders * Growing company with opportunities for advancement * Authenticity and accountability from leadership **Compensation Transparency** The compensation range for this position is $190,000 \- $210,000\. The posted cash compensation includes on\-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related considerations. **Equal Opportunity** *NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. At Realtor.com®, we're on a mission to make buying, selling, and living in homes easier and more rewarding for everyone. With over 70 million monthly users, we provide trusted data, tools, and guidance to help people make life's biggest decisions. Our team is passionate about simplifying the real estate journey, and we're just getting started. Organic search and organic social are two of the most important ways consumers find realtor.com. Behind organic search sits a platform of crawl, indexation, sitemap, structured\-data, and rendering systems; behind organic social sits the share experience and the deeplinking and attribution layer (AppsFlyer) that determines whether a shared listing actually lands the recipient on the right page, in\-app or on web. Together these span the layers that shape what search engines, social platforms, and end users see across millions of pages and shares. We're building a dedicated Organic Growth Engineering team — a platform team that owns the systems, tooling, and reliability behind organic search and organic social. As our Technical SEO \& Social Lead, you'll be the engineer who understands the whole ecosystem: from structured data on a listing page, to the delivery\-layer configuration that governs crawler access, to the deeplink resolution that fires when a listing gets shared — and who can drive fixes across the teams that own those systems. You'll set the technical direction for the team, serve as the voice of Organic Growth inside Engineering — advocating for SEO and social\-sharing best practices as the technical SME for the channel — and lead the response when organic search or organic social performance is at risk. You'll also be the primary technical counterpart to our Organic Growth product partners, including the VP, Organic Growth (SEO/AEO), turning their strategy into platform changes and giving them a clear, data\-backed answer on SEO\- and sharing\-critical proposals. Your north star: The goal is clear and the bar is high: become the \#1 non\-brand destination in organic search and answer engines while building the ultimate property listing sharing experience for real estate. On scope: Several systems that affect SEO and social sharing are owned by partner teams, so a lot of this job is understanding how they connect and driving the right owners to the fix. Comfort with ambiguity and strong cross\-team influence matter as much here as depth in any one codebase. Note for candidates: This is a senior engineering role, not a marketing SEO position. Experience with deeplinking/attribution infrastructure is a strong plus even without an SEO background\*.\* Nice to have * Deep technical\-SEO engineering expertise: demonstrable ownership of crawl budget, indexation, structured data, rendering, and site migrations at scale (ideally high\-traffic marketplace or content sites). * Deeplinking and attribution expertise: hands\-on experience with mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer or equivalent — Branch, Adjust), deep\-link generation, resolution, and attribution debugging. jobs.title: Subject Matter Expert, Investment Banking
jobs.description: Applied AI \- San Francisco **About the Team** OpenAI is building AI systems that can help professionals perform complexation, exercise judgment under pressure, and produce precise, defensible models, analyses, and client materials. Our team works across Research, Product, Engineering, and Go\-to\-Market to make OpenAI's models genuinely useful for these workflows. We translate real professional work into product requirements, evaluations, training signals, and repeatable customer solutions. We care not only whether a model can generate an answer, but whether it can deliver accurate, defensible work that experienced bankers can trust and use. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. **About the Role** We are looking for a Subject Matter Expert in Investment Banking to help define what excellent AI\-assisted banking work looks like and turn that standard into better models and products. You will bring deeped, including company and industry research, financial analysis and modeling, valuation, diligence, transaction execution, and the creation and review of client materials. You will use that expertise to design realistic tasks and evaluations, create and assess high\-quality reference work, diagnose model failures, and help our technical teams improve model behavior and product experiences. This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role for someone who enjoys both doing the work and explaining what makes it good. You should be comfortable moving between an Excel model, a presentation, a source document, an evaluation rubric, a product prototype, and a conversation with researchers or customers. You will help us distinguish outputs that merely look plausible from work that is accurate, traceable, internally consistent, and ready for serious professional use. **In This Role, You Will** * Define the quality bar for AI\-assisted investment banking work across research, financial analysis, valuation, modeling, diligence, transaction execution, and client materials. * Translate real banking workflows into challenging, representative evaluation tasks with realistic inputs, constraints, deliverables, and success criteria. * Create and refine banker\-grade reference artifacts, including financial models, valuation analyses, diligence materials, screening outputs, pitch books, committee materials, and transaction documents. * Develop rigorous rubrics and grading methods that assess financial correctness, analytical judgment, source quality, traceability, internal consistency, presentation quality, and practical usefulness. * Evaluate model outputs and end\-to\-end agent workflows, identify recurring failure modes, and translate findings into actionable feedback for Research, Engineering, and Product. * Partner with researchers and engineers on evalsance on financial work. * Work closely with product teams to identify the highest\-value opportunities for AI in investment banking, prototype new workflows using OpenAI tools, and assess whether early experiences meet the needs of real users. * Engage with customers, design partners, and domain reviewers to understand real\-world standards and constraints, support testing and adoption, codify domain knowledge, and ensure responsible financial\-services deployment. **You Might Thrive in This Role If You** * Have 2\+ years of investment banking experience, including live transaction execution and the production of high\-quality analyses, financial models, and client materials. Demonstrated ability and judgment matter more than title or tenure. * Have strong command of core banking workflows across M\&A, capital raising, strategic advisory, or a closely related product or coverage area. * Can build and review financial analyses in Excel and produce polished PowerPoint materials, with a sharp eye for errors, weak assumptions, unsupported claims, inconsistent numbers, and poor presentation. * Understand how work and judgment evolve from junior analyst through director, and can identify where AI should automate execution, support decision\-making, or remain subject to human review. * Exercise excellent analytical judgment and can assess whether an approach is appropriate, evidence is sufficient, and an output would withstand senior review. * Can translate expert intuition into clear standards, actionable feedback, rubrics, and guidance that others and evaluation systems can apply consistently. * Thrive in ambiguous, zero\-to\-one environments and are willing to create the first version of a task, model, deck, rubric, workflow prototype, or playbook. * Are curious about AI, comfortable collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and able to apply sound judgment around confidentiality, data entitlements, governance, regulation, and reputational risk. **Especially Strong Candidates May Also Have** * Experience across multiple banking products, industry coverage groups, geographies, or transaction types, or in adjacent fields such as private equity, corporate development, equity research, private credit, leveraged finance, or restructuring. * A track record of improving financial workflows through automation, templates, knowledge systems, data tools, process redesign, or new technology. * Familiarity with evaluation design, quality assurance, benchmarking, data annotation, prompt design, or testing AI\-enabled financial tools. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable lawation technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non\-compliant. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $185K – $205K \+ Offers Equity

jobs.title: AI ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Machine Learning Research Engineer** Urgent Hiring Requirement **Minimum Qualification: PhD** in a relevant technical field. This is an urgent requirement with an anticipated start date within 2 weeks. Priority will be given to candidates who can interview promptly and begin within two weeks of selection. **Job Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated Machine Learning Research Engineer (ScientificEngineering AI) with strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, and AI research. This role is intended exclusively for PhD graduates or candidates near completion from reputable universities. Candidates with a strong academic research background in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Data Science, Scientific Computing, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Applied Physics, Computational Engineering, or related fields are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates will combine strong ML/DL expertise with domain knowledge in mechanical engineering, materials science, manufacturing systems, physical systems, scientific computing, or simulation\-driven engineering applications. Research experience gained during a PhD program will be considered equivalent to professional industry experience. This is an urgent hiring requirement, and we are actively seeking candidates who can start within the next 2 weeks. **Education Requirement** PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Applied Physics, Computational Engineering, or a related technical field. Candidates currently pursuing a PhD with anticipated graduation within the next 3\-6 months are also encouraged to apply. Only PhD candidates will be considered for this role. Candidates with only a Master's degree will not be considered. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, train, and optimize Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for real\-world applications. Own the complete ML lifecycle including data collection, annotation, preprocessing, model training, fine\-tuning, evaluation, optimization, and deployment. Develop and deploy advanced deep learning architectures including CNNs, LSTMs, ConvLSTMs, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Reinforcement Learning, and Transformer\-based models. Conduct experiments, evaluate model performance, and drive continuous algorithmic improvements. Work with large\-scale datasets for model training, validation, and testing. Optimize and deploy AI models for scalable and efficient real\-world applications. Translate research concepts into scalable, production\-ready AI systems. Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering and research teams to integrate ML models into real\-world applications. Document methodologies, experimental findings, and technical solutions. Contribute to technical innovation initiatives and advanced AI research activities. **Required Qualifications** Strong PhD research background in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Data Science, Scientific Machine Learning, Computational Engineering, Applied Physics, Materials Informatics, or related areas. Strong programming experience with Python and C\+\+. Hands\-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit\-learn, or similar ML frameworks. Strong understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Computer Vision, and AI algorithms. Experience developing and training advanced deep learning models and architectures. Solid mathematical foundation in linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimization, and applied machine learning. Experience working with Linux environments, Git, Docker, and modern development workflows. Demonstrated research experience through publications, thesis work, academic research projects, or equivalent research contributions. Strong ability to independently research, prototype, and deploy AI solutions. Experience applying machine learning or deep learning techniques to engineering, manufacturing, materials science, physical systems, scientific computing, simulation, or industrial applications is highly desirable. **Preferred Qualifications** Publications in leading AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Scientific Computing, Computational Engineering, Materials Science, or Applied Physics conferences and journals. Experience transitioning AI/ML models from research environments into production systems. Experience with CUDA, GPU acceleration, distributed computing, high\-performance computing (HPC), or parallel computing environments. Experience handling large\-scale, real\-world datasets. Familiarity with Physics\-Informed Machine Learning (PIML), Physics\-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), scientific foundation models, digital twins, simulation\-driven AI, or engineering optimization techniques. Experience working with data generated from CAD, CAE, CFD, FEA, multiphysics simulations, manufacturing processes, materials characterization, laboratory testing, or other engineering and scientific workflows. **Technical Skills** Python, C\+\+ PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit\-learn Machine Learning and Deep Learning Computer Vision Reinforcement Learning Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) Transformer Architectures Linux, Git, Docker CUDA and GPU Computing Scientific Computing and Optimization Physics\-Informed Machine Learning (Preferred) Engineering and Scientific Data Analysis (Preferred)

jobs.title: Product Manager/Strategy 4-ProdDev
jobs.description: Help define how enterprises build AI workloads on their most valuable data and operate them at industrial scale . You will own the strategy and execution for a major area of Oracle Database AI platform. You will work directly with developers and enterprise customers to identify the problems that prevent AI applications from reaching production, then turn those needs into products customers can adopt and operate at scale. You will shape how developers connect agents to enterprise data, use models and tools, evaluate behavior, diagnose failures, and apply security and governance controls. You will translate these workflows into APIs, SDKs, visual tools, and operational experiences. You will work closely with engineering, design, applied AI, and go\-to\-market teams. You will make product and technical decisions involving developer experience, architecture, quality, latency, reliability, security, scalability, and cost. As a senior individual contributor, you will influence the direction of Oracle Database’s AI platform. You will own the vision, strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for a major area of Oracle Database’s AI platform. You will work directly with developers, AI engineers, architects, and enterprise customers to uncover problems in building and operating production AI applications and agents. You will turn customer evidence and advances in AI into products that solve durable, high\-value problems. You will reduce the time and effort required to move AI applications from prototype to production. You will shape APIs, SDKs, tools, and workflows that developers can learn quickly and operate confidently at enterprise scale. You will define how agents securely retrieve enterprise data, use tools, maintain context, and produce grounded results. You will shape evaluation and observability experiences that help customers measure quality, diagnose failures, and improve agent behavior. You will partner with engineering to make tradeoffs involving model quality, latency, reliability, security, interoperability, scalability, and cost. You will prototype with models, APIs, agent frameworks, and developer tools to test assumptions before committing engineering investment. You will use customer research, product telemetry, evaluations, and market evidence to determine what to build, improve, or stop. You will recruit design partners and work with them from initial discovery through production deployment and adoption. You will connect Oracle’s database, cloud, application, and developer capabilities into cohesive AI development workflows. You will measure success through developer adoption, time to first working application, time to production, production workload growth, quality, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency. You will write product narratives, requirements, decision documents, and investment proposals that align engineering teams and senior leaders. You will analyze competing platforms, open\-source technologies, and emerging AI architectures to identify changes in customer expectations and opportunities for differentiation. You will partner with go\-to\-market teams on positioning, pricing, technical enablement, customer briefings, launches, and adoption. You will represent the product with customers, partners, senior executives, and the AI developer community. You will strengthen product\-management practices and mentor other product managers

jobs.description: **About Orchard** Orchard is transforming the way people buy and sell their homes. Simplifying it, to the way it should have always been; fair and true to market, straightforward, easy. Every year in the U.S., $1\.5 trillion of single family homes transact, generating over $120 billion of fees in a process that has changed little in decades. Our team builds the systems behind Orchard's website and the tools that help agents reach new customers. We focus on helping people explore homes, book consultations, and connect with our agents. Our site serves over 150k unique visitors each month and sees about 700k pageviews. The team partners closely with marketing, product, and design to support new campaigns, track performance, and ensure the site is fast and reliable at scale. You'll work on the systems that make this possible \- backend, frontend, or both, depending on where the work takes you. That means building and improving APIs, data services, and integrations that support both customers and agents. Your work will touch many parts of the systems our team owns. We build and maintain the services that bring new customers into Orchard, from the public website and intake flows, to scheduling and consultation booking. We also support the tools that help our agents work with those customers, like managing and syncing leads, powering outreach, and maintaining privacy and consent systems that keep customer data safe and compliant. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and business stakeholders to plan and ship projects. The team is small and moves quickly, so you'll have real ownership and visibility in your work. Most of our engineering work today is agent\-driven: we use tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Codex daily, and the job is less about typing code yourself and more about scoping the work well, directing AI tools effectively, and catching it when they get something wrong. We're looking for engineers who are good at that loop, not just comfortable with AI tools existing. This is a full\-time role that will report into our Senior Software Engineer and be based out of the New York office, where we are in office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. **What You'll Do Here** * Build and maintain the services and interfaces that power Orchard's website and internal tools. Most of our stack uses Qwik on the frontend and Python with Postgres and OpenSearch on the backend, though some other services use React and TypeScript. * Work with product and design to turn ideas into clear, well\-scoped projects. * Debug and improve core services to make them faster and more reliable as we prepare for national growth over the next 12\-18 months. * Ensure our systems can scale smoothly as our user base continues to grow. * Write clean, tested code that's easy to understand and maintain. * Help improve developer workflows, testing, and documentation. * Take part in on\-call rotations and own the systems you build. * Work with a small team that values communication, trust, and practical solutions. * Use AI coding tools like Claude Code, Copilot, and Codex as part of your daily workflow to build and ship features efficiently. * Comfortable reviewing code you didn't write **We'd Love to Hear From You if You Have** * At least 2\+ years of experience as a software engineer. * Strong skills in at least one language relevant to our stack (Python, TypeScript, or Go), with solid knowledge of APIs and data modeling. * Experience with tools like AWS, Postgres, SQL, Kafka, Airflow, Docker, or CircleCI is a plus. * Experience directing AI coding tools effectively * A low\-ego, problem\-solving mindset. You take ownership, improve what you touch, and ask for help when something doesn't add up. * Interest in a hands\-on team where engineers ship quickly and have real impact. *For NYC residents only: The pay range for this position in New York City is $130,000\-$150,000/year. The actual base pay offered may vary within the range provided depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Stock options and other incentive pay may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City.* *Orchard is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.*

jobs.title: DevOps Manager, Platform
jobs.description: Overview: A great platform team is defined not by how many tickets it closes, but by how little friction stands between an engineer's idea and a running service, because the team built the pipelines, golden paths, and AI\-augmented workflows that make delivery self\-service. The DevOps Manager, Platform is the people leader and hands\-on technical operator who makes that true at Origami Risk. This manager leads the team that builds, runs, and continuously improves the developer platform and delivery automation that Engineering teams depend on to ship every day, spanning CI/CD pipelines and shared templates, service\-layer Terraform, the EKS container platform and capabilities golden path, application connectivity and service data stores, environment promotion, and the AI tooling layered on top. Everything runs in AWS, on top of the landing zone the Cloud Infrastructure team owns. This is a hands\-on technical leader who coaches Engineers on platform\-engineering craft, sets a high bar for delivery reliability and operational discipline, drives AI adoption into daily DevOps workflows, and partners with Engineering, Release, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure so that the path to production is a source of competitive advantage and not a constraint on what Engineering can deliver. On this team, manual work is a problem to be solved, automation is the default, and every Engineer is expected to use AI to work faster and diagnose more accurately. Starting base pay for this role is between $145,000 and $185,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: **What this team runs:** This is the developer platform and delivery layer that sits on top of the AWS landing zone — the systems Engineering uses to build, ship, and operate services every day. The team owns the platform for application and service delivery, not the landing zone underneath it. The team owns: * **Delivery Pipelines \& Build:** the CI/CD build and deploy pipelines, and the shared pipeline templates that Engineering teams across the org use to ship every day. * **Service\-Layer IaC:** the infrastructure\-as\-code that defines each service's cloud resources, versioned and deployed through Terraform. * **Kubernetes \& Container Platform:** the EKS container platform and the self\-service golden path that lets a new service onboard with no bespoke infrastructure work. * **Application Connectivity:** the application\-facing API gateways, service DNS, and certificates that make services reachable and secure. * **Service Data \& Configuration:** the application data stores, configuration, and secrets that each service depends on. * **Environment Promotion:** the promotion path that moves a change safely from lower environments to production. * **AI \& Internal Tooling:** the AI tooling across the development lifecycle that speeds service onboarding, pipeline authoring, and day\-to\-day delivery. **Key responsibilities:** ***People Leadership \& Team Development*** * Leads, develops, and retains a team of DevOps Engineers building the developer platform, cultivating a high\-performance culture defined by technical excellence, an automation mindset, and operational ownership. * Sets clear goals, role expectations, and success criteria for each engineer; conducts regular 1:1s and gives direct, constructive feedback with a visible path for growth. * Conducts structured performance reviews that recognize strong delivery contributions, address quality or reliability gaps specifically, and grow both AI fluency and platform\-engineering depth. * Identifies capability gaps across the team, encompassing CI/CD, service\-layer Terraform, container orchestration and EKS, API and connectivity patterns, and AI\-assisted operations, while building targeted hiring, upskilling, and cross\-training plans. * Fosters a culture where every manual process is a temporary state, automation is the permanent solution, and AI tooling is an expected part of how each engineer works. * Supports Engineering hiring across the organization by participating in technical interviews and helping calibrate the platform\-engineering bar. ***Developer Platform \& Delivery Operations*** * Owns the end\-to\-end path from “we are building a service” to “it deploys to production on its own pipeline”, repository scaffolding, ECR, Terraform workspace, pipeline, variable groups, secrets paths, hostname, gateway wiring, and alarms, reducing the elapsed time and ownership ambiguity in new\-service onboarding. * Leads the team's service\-layer infra , and effective coordination. ***Preferred Qualifications*** * AWS certification at the associate or professional level (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer – Professional). * Experience building a self\-service developer platform or golden path for service onboarding. * Experience with Kubernetes platform engineering, Helm chart libraries, ExternalDNS, and gateway/authorizer patterns. * Experience with Terraform Cloud / HCP and migrating workspaces to S3 and DynamoDB backends. * Experience implementing SRE practices, SLOs and error budgets, in partnership with an SRE team. * Familiarity with Temporal or AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration in deployment pipelines. * Experience supporting compliance frameworks, SOC 2, NIST 800\-53, or ISO/IEC 27001, including control evidence and audit readiness for delivery systems. * Experience evaluating and adopting AI\-native developer\-productivity or deployment\-intelligence tools, AI\-assisted deployment risk scoring or LLM\-powered operational runbook generation. Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. We have received reports of individuals impersonating Origami Risk recruiters to deceive candidates into disclosing personal information. These impostors use fake Origami Risk domain names and email addresses. Please double\-check that any email address from an Origami Risk recruiter ends with* *origamirisk.com* *or* *talent.icims.com**. And to confirm the legitimacy of any recruiting communication, feel free to email* *transparencycheck@origamirisk.com**.*
